body.name: Canonical embedded ordinary full-kernel batch certificate \(E_{\mathbf B}\)
body.construction: Let \(\mathbf B\) be ordinary full-kernel identifying.  Acquire \(\mathcal P_{\mathbf B}=\{S_B:B\in\{B_1,\ldots,B_t\}_{\mathrm{distinct}}\}\), all labels in \(\Lambda_{\mathbf B}\), and the canonical single-district factors of their laws.  For each target cell \((x,s)\), run the complete single-world procedure and apply the sparse switching normal form, choosing the lexicographically first successful witness for each concrete branch.  The resulting family \((E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{x,s})_{x,s}\), together with the shared paid protocol set \(\mathcal P_{\mathbf B}\), is \(E_{\mathbf B}\).  Protocols in \(\mathcal P_{\mathbf B}\) are charged once even when used by several cells or slices.
